seasonal_load_source: EIA EBA actual-demand UTC D.H series, archived 2026-06-02
peak_selection: 100 largest positive reported hourly demands per complete local summer
fallback: common complete years only, with incomplete-year coverage disclosed
national_benchmarks: 390 and 430 TWh in 2030; separately labeled cross-source endpoint scenarios
benchmark_annual_rule: same 2025 LBNL reference anchor, constant fractional growth through 2030; three existing post-2030 extensions
spatial_scope: retain reported records; exclude explicit pure cryptocurrency in scope-matched alternatives; mixed use and power-campus quantities separately tested
